project.name: Solution Manager :: mesh-events
project.description:
Shared event envelope model (backend design §3), package root com.solace.sm.events. Scaffold — Task 9 of plan 001 fills it; dependencies are added there, not speculatively here.
PLANE-NEUTRAL BY CONTRACT: this module must never depend on cp-* or dp-*. That neutrality is what makes it safe for either plane to consume, and what stops it becoming an I7 conduit (dp-core -> mesh-events -> cp-api) that the direct ArchUnit plane rules would not see and that Maven would happily put on dp-core's classpath. Enforced by PlaneBoundaryTest.eventsNeverImportCp / eventsNeverImportDp.
Jackson is neither cp nor dp, so it does not touch that neutrality. No version is written here: every artifact below is managed by the Spring Boot 3.5.16 parent BOM (jackson-bom, junit-bom), so versions come from the BOM, never from memory (I2).
